# Heat transfer basics

## Convection

Convective heat transfer depends on the **heat transfer coefficient**, which links the heat flux to the temperature difference between a surface and the fluid. In forced convection the Reynolds number of the flow largely determines this coefficient.

## 对流换热

对流换热系数描述了流体与固体表面之间的换热能力，它与流速和流体物性有关。
